## Exploring the KM-GBF model database

This is a walkthrough of how to explore the KM-GBF model database at xxxx.

## Loading in the database

You can load the database in with the function *LoadDatabaseinR*

```{r}
targets::tar_source("R")
        model_database <- LoadDatabaseInR(dataset_path = "input/KMGBF-NFF model dataset_20260626.xlsx")


```

## What variables can we visualize?

Not all questions lend themselves easily to visualisations so when exploring the database it is good to know which columns contain information that we can plot.

```{r}

visual_columns <- .ColumnsWithAttributes(model_database)

head(visual_columns)

visual_columns
```

It is through these columns that we can go and explore the database

## Metadata figures - Review manuscript

For the review manuscript we want to produce plots that demonstrate the representativness of the dataset in terms of how well the different models can inform the KM-GBF goals and targets, NFF value persepctives, scenario analysis capabilities etc.

Here we have some functions that can display the metadata in a radar bar chart, also displaying the percentage of the models that fall into each category. 

```{r}

if(!dir.exists("outputs/review_ms/metadata")) {
  dir.create("outputs/review_ms/metadata", recursive = TRUE)
}

# NFF value perspectives

NFF <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[40], colour_bars = TRUE, radial = TRUE)


ggplot2::ggsave(NFF,filename = "outputs/review_ms/metadata/NFF.png",  device = "png", width = 30.5, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)

# Km-GBF goals

Goals <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[30],colour_bars = TRUE, radial = TRUE)


ggplot2::ggsave(Goals,filename = "outputs/review_ms/metadata/kmgbf_goals.png",  device = "png", width = 30.5, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)

# KM-GBF Targets

Targets <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[32], colour_bars = TRUE, radial = TRUE)


ggplot2::ggsave(Targets,filename = "outputs/review_ms/metadata/kmgbf_targets.png",  device = "png", width = 30.5, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)

# Scenario analysis

Scenario_analysis <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[24], colour_bars = TRUE, radial = TRUE)


ggplot2::ggsave(Scenario_analysis,filename = "outputs/review_ms/metadata/scenario_analysis.png",  device = "png", width = 30.5, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)

# Detection and attribution - Here this figure is a bit more bespoke but doable

Detection_and_attribution <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[15], colour_bars = TRUE, radial = TRUE)


ggplot2::ggsave(Detection_and_attribution,filename = "outputs/review_ms/metadata/detection_and_attribution.png",  device = "png", width = 30.5, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)


# Methodological approach

Approach <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[12], colour_bars = TRUE, radial = TRUE)


ggplot2::ggsave(Approach,filename = "outputs/review_ms/metadata/method_approach.png",  device = "png", width = 30.5, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)

# regional scale

Scale <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[3], colour_bars = TRUE, radial = TRUE)


ggplot2::ggsave(Scale,filename = "outputs/review_ms/metadata/regional_scale.png",  device = "png", width = 30.5, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)




```

## Metadata figures - data manuscript
These figures are for the data paper again showing teh descriptive statistics but in a flat bar chart format.

### Figure 1

```{r}

if(!dir.exists("outputs/db_ms/metadata")) {
  dir.create("outputs/db_ms/metadata", recursive = TRUE)
}

# Realm

Realm <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[4])



ggplot2::ggsave(Realm,filename = "outputs/db_ms/metadata/realm_flat.png",  device = "png", width = 35, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)

# Drivers

Drivers <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[8])


ggplot2::ggsave(Drivers,filename = "outputs/db_ms/metadata/drivers_flat.png",  device = "png", width = 35, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)

# Domain

Domain <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[2])


ggplot2::ggsave(Domain,filename = "outputs/db_ms/metadata/domain_flat.png",  device = "png", width = 35, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)

# Approach

Approach <- ResponseCount(database = model_database,
              response = visual_columns[12])


ggplot2::ggsave(Approach,filename = "outputs/db_ms/metadata/method_approach_flat.png",  device = "png", width = 35, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 400)


arranged_1 <- ggpubr::ggarrange(Domain, Realm,Drivers, Approach, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv", common.legend = TRUE, legend = "none")


ggplot2::ggsave(arranged_1,filename = "outputs/db_ms/metadata/figure_1.png",width = 70, height = 80,unit = "cm", dpi = 400,  device = "png")

```

              response = visual_columns[40])

              response = visual_columns[30])
